S13.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: a square flat continuous fabric texture for existing suit S13 in a wardrobe app. Input image 1 is the real close-up rear shoulder textile and controls actual yarn and check structure. Input image 2 is a tighter crop of the same fine plaid and controls the interlocking structure. Input image 3 is the real front photograph and controls how subordinate the overall checks are. Extract/reconstruct only this exact fine dark navy-blue glen-plaid suiting into a flat straight-on uniformly illuminated fabric swatch filling the square. Preserve the characteristic closely spaced parallel thread bundles crossing at right angles with tiny broken/interlocking toothlike motifs between bundles; the alternating fine weave zones have similar average brightness. Faithfully follow the reference yarn density and motif proportions. Do not substitute a generic windowpane or tartan, do not create repeated empty rectangular boxes, no broad horizontal bands, no large stripes, no bright white crossing grid. The fine alternating thread groups should carry the design, densely filling all regions; no blank dark square centers. Fine smooth matte tightly woven worsted appearance, not tweed or linen, not chunky individual fuzzy yarns. Very low-contrast blue on navy; darker navy field, lighter desaturated blue threads, not neutral gray, not black. Exactly flat orthographic cloth, no perspective, no folds, no shadows or gradients. Fabric only edge to edge, no garment shape, body, face, collar, pockets, seam, labels, borders, text, or UI. Treat the inputs as photographic material references only. Output one seamless high-fidelity square swatch, no comparison montage. The application will use only texture luminance and will retain the fixed photographic color target and all original garment/portrait pixels separately.
